name: frozen-quill-rest-loads-itself-into-an-unloaded-bow
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php. (The Opportunity window opened by the new field ability is left pending.)

rulesClauses: [REST]: Load CARDNAME into target unloaded Bow weapon you control.

engineBug.summary: Frozen Quill's field activation was misrouted through ActivateCard (the [REST] cost was never paid).
